title: 移动
review: couldfile_review20260814.md 二、核心功能设计·移动 / 三、复制与移动流程
comment: Executable form of the review checklist `couldfile_review20260814.md` for this module. channel: `api` = assertable over HTTP by tests/e2e/review_<module>_matrix.py; channel: `ui` = browser-only, reported as skipped by the API matrix and deferred to a future browser suite. perm is the CE permission level the principal exercises (r / rw / admin / none / n/a); the five-level role model is NOT adopted (see docs/roles-semantics.md), so role-level cases are absent by design.

cases.name: move requires source move/delete permission
cases.review: 校验来源移动/删除权限
cases.expect: moving from a source the user cannot write is rejected (403)

cases.name: move requires target create permission
cases.review: 校验目标目录新建权限
cases.expect: moving into a read-only target directory is rejected (403)

cases.name: cross-space move requires elevated permission
cases.review: 跨团队空间移动增加更高权限控制
cases.expect: a cross-space move is rejected unless the user holds admin

cases.name: move warns about permission-inheritance change
cases.review: 移动前提示权限影响（如 N 名成员可能失去访问）
cases.expect: the move precheck reports the number of members who would lose access

cases.name: move rejects cyclic directory move
cases.expect: moving a folder into its own subtree is rejected

cases.name: move enforces same-name conflict policy
cases.expect: a name conflict resolves by policy, never a silent overwrite

cases.name: move runs precheck-async-report with idempotent task id
cases.review: 预检查—异步执行—结果报告；任务 ID 幂等
cases.expect: move returns a task id and a duplicate submission does not move the item twice

cases.name: move preview reports affected members without moving
cases.review: 移动权限影响确认框的后端预检（preview 不落库）
cases.expect: fileops/move with preview=true returns affected_members and leaves the source file in place
